Industry data indicates the rise in attacks has slowed the recent recovery of oil shipments through the strait.

snapshots.title: Global hedge funds suffer steep losses as AI trade unwinds, Asia funds hit hardest
snapshots.summary: Global hedge funds suffered steep losses as investors unwound artificial intelligence-related trades amid inflation concerns and expectations of higher interest rates. Asia-focused stock pickers were hit hardest, losing 6.8% in early October, while global fundamental long-short funds fell 2.9% through October 15, according to Goldman Sachs data cited by Reuters.

snapshots.title: India’s forex reserves fall to $726.03 bn in week ended Oct 9
snapshots.summary: The Reserve Bank of India reported that foreign‑exchange reserves declined by $8.578 billion, to $726.027 billion, in the week ended 9 October. The fall followed a $12.952 billion decline in the previous week. The decrease was driven by lower foreign‑currency assets, reduced gold holdings, and drops in special drawing rights and the IMF reserve position.

snapshots.title: India aims for $100 billion bilateral trade with Russia by 2030
snapshots.summary: Indian Ambassador to Russia Vinay Kumar said India is negotiating a free‑trade agreement with the Eurasian Economic Union to boost exports. He projected that total India‑Russia trade will reach about US$100 billion by 2030, up from roughly US$38 billion recorded in the first half of the current year. The government is working to diversify its export basket and improve market access in Russia.

snapshots.title: Masked settlers attack olive harvest in West Bank, injuring Palestinians and journalist
snapshots.summary: Dozens of masked settlers attacked Palestinians harvesting olives near the village of Abu Falah in the occupied West Bank, setting fire to cars and olive trees. The violence injured 12 Palestinians, including four who hold dual Palestinian‑American citizenship, and also wounded a foreign journalist. One of the injured, Majdi, an American citizen, suffered deep head wounds from nail‑studded sticks, and his elderly mother was also hurt.

The Reserve Bank of India stepped into the market to support the rupee, which has been among the weakest Asian currencies this year. The drawdown reflects the central bank’s effort to stabilise the currency.

snapshots.title: India's forex reserves shed $60 billion in six weeks as RBI steps in to support rupee, one of Asia's worst-performing currencies this year
snapshots.summary: India’s foreign exchange reserves declined by nearly $60 billion in six weeks to $726.027 billion as of October 9, from a record high of $785.706 billion on September 4.
